id_status: PROPOSED: reuses the P20-reserved id and role 'crawl_map_documents_and_bounded_web_jobs' (docs/p20/sg000092_architecture_freeze.json) out of its recorded sequential order; founder decision FD-UP-4 may allocate a new id instead
title: Embedded job queue; asynchronous crawl, map and batch scrape over MCP and loopback

dependency_notes.SG-000131: Job state machine, audit chain, error codes.
dependency_notes.SG-000101: Scrape options, engines and the harness; batch scrape units are scrapes.
dependency_notes.SG-000108: Closed. crawl.rs, crawl_scope.rs, map_rank.rs, robots and sitemaps (slice 7, #317) are reused in place; their limits stay.

objective: Add crates/orcel-jobs, an embedded durable job queue with no server database and no async runtime (per-unit leases, dedup by normalized URL, per-origin politeness throttle, bounded retry with backoff for read-only units only, concurrency 1 to 4, checkpoint and resume that reports interrupted units as outcome_unknown, a bounded expiring result store), porting ideas from Crawlee (Apache-2.0) and Scrapling (BSD-3-Clause) without copying files. Expose the existing tested crawl and map code through Firecrawl v2 routes (POST /v2/map, POST /v2/crawl, GET and DELETE /v2/crawl/{id}, GET /v2/crawl/{id}/errors, /v2/crawl/ongoing and /active, POST /v2/batch/scrape and its status, cancel and errors routes, with v1 aliases for map and crawl) and MCP tools web_map, web_crawl_start, web_batch_scrape_start, web_job_status, web_job_cancel, web_job_errors and web_job_list.

include: crates/orcel-jobs: queue, throttle, retry, concurrency, checkpoint and store modules (section 4.11 of the spec); the job state machine of section 4.7 with no new state.

orceld: capabilities web.map, web.crawl, web.batch_scrape, job.status, job.cancel, job.errors, job.list; one SOFT approval per job bound to the full spec digest in Safe mode (subject to FD-UP-5); every page navigation still governed by SG-000075; cancel and emergency stop reach running units.
orcel-web: map, crawl and batch request types and the status mapping of section 5.5.
apps/orcel-mcp: the seven tool_contract entries (local_only) and the loopback routes listed in the objective.
tests/firecrawl-compat rows for map, crawl and batch.
exclude: Webhooks or any outbound callback from a job.
Subdomains, external links or whole-domain crawls (one admitted destination).
Crawl prompts, extract and other model-backed rows (Wave 3).
Any Firecrawl AGPL file; any Crawlee or Scrapling file copied verbatim.

authority_delta.jobs: Proposed: bounded asynchronous web jobs (at most 8 queued, 2 running, 1,000 URLs remembered, depth 5, 100 URLs per batch) admitted by one SOFT approval per job spec in Safe mode. No new network class, no listener beyond the existing loopback server, no persistent browser profile, no job egress.

decisions.question: Job approval granularity in Safe mode

invariants: Job states are exactly not_started, dispatched, completed, cancelled and outcome_unknown.
outcome_unknown is never retried automatically; mutating units are never retried.
A job approval binds the canonical spec digest and cannot be replayed for a different spec.
A restarted orceld reports interrupted units as outcome_unknown and never re-runs them silently.
The crawl origin is the boundary; filters only narrow it.
Result storage is bounded and expires; it lives under the private state root.
acceptance: State machine property tests show no transition outside the table of section 4.7.
Crash-resume test passes on all three OSes.
Per-origin delay is honoured within 10 ms of the configured value on all three OSes.
Cancel reaches cancelled within 2 s and no page is fetched after the cancel is acknowledged (journey J-2).
Every W1 map, crawl and batch row of the parity matrix passes the SDK harness.
A fresh-context security judge passes the orceld dispatch slice.

review.alibaba_open_code_review: delegation mode per standing founder decision (2026-10-10) with manual review of excluded files
review.security_review: fresh-context security judge on every slice and on closeout; d1-local advisory only
